Package com.hiface.sdk.liveness

Interface FaceLivenessApi

public interface FaceLivenessApi
RGB passive/action camera liveness and independent single-image infrared evaluation. Obtain it from HiFaceSdk.liveness().

The SDK supplies the implementation; applications do not implement or construct this interface.

  • Method Details

    • evaluateInfrared

      @NonNull default HiFaceResult<InfraredLivenessResult> evaluateInfrared(@NonNull InfraredFrame frame, float realThreshold)
      Synchronous IR-only FLIR inference. Call on a worker thread. The threshold applies to realScore and must be calibrated for the target IR camera. This does not acquire a camera, detect a face, or start an RGB flow.

    • startCameraLiveness

      @NonNull FaceRequest startCameraLiveness(@NonNull FaceLivenessConfig config, @NonNull FaceFlowListener listener)
      Passive and action liveness share liveness.rgb. A complete camera flow also uses detect, capture, and feature. Start one camera-liveness flow. Defaults to zero actions; configured actions run first. Default detection retains two faces to reject multiple-face scenes reliably. Obtain the image through FaceFlowResult.getAlignedFace(). Listener methods are dispatched asynchronously on the main thread.
